name: zhao-lusi-crimson-editorial
image_purpose: luxury lookbook and multi-scene fashion campaign

prompt.project_info: Create an 8K high-fashion editorial series with a crimson chiffon gown, black tailored blazer, and cinematic wet-look beauty styling.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional East Asian woman with original non-celebrity features, serene elegant expression, clean low bun, high-shine dewy skin, polished natural makeup with coral lip gloss, floral-shaped silver or crystal earrings, and a chunky statement ring. She wears a vibrant crimson strapless chiffon gown with vertical ruffled tiers, an oversized matte-black tailored blazer draped over the shoulders, and black open-toe heeled sandals.
prompt.composition_elements: Three scenes: full-length walking shot holding a generic blue patterned phone with gown ruffles flowing; close-up portrait with warm directional light on dewy skin and collarbone; seated sculptural pose with chiffon folds and blazer silhouette. Maintain shallow bokeh and subject focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional cinematic lighting, warm directional close-up light, glossy but realistic skin and chiffon reflections, elegant crimson-black atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R IV-inspired 85mm f/1.8 look, 8K-style detail, shallow depth of field, sharp subject, natural anatomy, photorealistic fabric and jewelry texture, no logos or text.
